messages.author: d128bd7b4bae8e43
messages.subject: crash when running compiled MCMC
parts:
Hi,
I'm experiencing something new that I have no idea how to debug.

I have a model using a distribution of my own. The model compiles without problem. Then I configure an MCMC and I compile it, again without problem. But when i try to run the compiled MCMC Rstudio crashes.
The MCMC works fine in the uncompiled version and, after some testing, I found that it seems to crash before even running the first line of the first sample. I even tried creating an MCMC with only an empty sampler (i.e. doing absolutely nothing) but it still crashes...

As I have no idea what the compiled MCMC is doing before calling the samplers I'm quite lost as to what I should look into.

I could send a script generating the error if necessary.

Thanks !
Rémi

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: crash when running compiled MCMC
parts:
Rémi, thanks for following up off-list with a reproducible example.  I'll respond here to describe the problem and a fix, to help others as well.

I found that, at present, the use of "numeric" or equivalently "nimNumeric" results in a segfault, from compiled execution in a model.  I'll file an issue with the nimble team, to look into this problem.  But for now, Rémi, an easy workaround for you is to use "rep(0, nbStades)" in your model code, instead of your call to "nimNumeric".  I'm happy to say this has nothing to do with the MCMC or the samplers.  Please let me know if this gets your code working.

For anyone else, here is a minimal reproducible example of the error that was encountered:


library(nimble)

## this works:
code <- nimbleCode({ a[1:5] <- rep(0, 5) })
Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code)
Rmodel$a
Cmodel <- compileNimble(Rmodel)
Cmodel$calculate('a')

## this fails:
code <- nimbleCode({ a[1:5] <- numeric(5) })
Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code)
Rmodel$a
Cmodel <- compileNimble(Rmodel)
Cmodel$calculate('a')   ## segfault
